title: Quint B NDE 976
content:
I was in London, one night friends brought me to a young woman that was in delirium. (drugs or alcohol, I never found out) They had met her and didn't know what to do with her. I made her lie down , she cried, screamed, and I did what I could to calm her and talk softly and stroke her hair. I was 19 years old and did not know what else to do. After a long moment she calmed down and told me she was cold, so I connected an electric radiator. As no heat was coming forth, I met my one hand on the radiator and the other one on the socket. In that moment I was electrocuted. This is what I went through: I moved very quickly as drawn into and to a very strong and at the same time very sweet light. Then, in that light and sweetness, I was one with the other souls in total harmony. Our collective consciousness told me that I couldn't stay because I had something else to do Being part of this consciousness, and a bit disappointed that I had to leave I went back into my body. The return in my body was violent: I heard someone screaming and I understood that this was I who had come back. I opened my eyes, a friend who was a fireman living in the same building had heard me and had hurried to rescue me. A friend present told me that she saw me glued to the radiator and the socket and then jump backwards 2 or 3 meters and falling down on my bed. ( Where I regained the ground). I did not go to hospital, to me this was but a small incident. My whole body shook for several hours and the first night I found it difficult to get my feet back in this reality. Sounds, colors and sensations where almost painfully strong experiences.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death. I was being electrocuted.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I was part of our collective consciousness.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes I was drawn into a light then I was part of it.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes These were no beings with bodies but souls: a collective consciousness.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes Very white, very pure, and very sweet.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe Yes, I will tell later.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will. I left my body and became part of collective consciousness. I understood that I had to come back because I had to do something here. I was disappointed but accepted and understood that I had taken part in the decision.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes The colors, the sensations, views, the communications (both in word and feeling) have no equivalent in our language to describe and explain these experiences.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Uncertain: Yes and No, I am born with psychic and paranormal gifts.
elements.What emotions did you feel after the exp: Fulfilled, total happiness exists, no desires , no needs, of everything that makes us human.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The best :the sensation of being fulfilled, the worst : the first hours of my return.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Total incomprehension, thus I no longer talk about it.
